target: Windows 10/11 + full AutoCAD 2026 + Codex MCP host
slacker_source: https://github.com/Slacker-LLC/autocad-mcp (main by default, -SlackerRef pins it; gated by doctor tool + parameter contract check)
felix_source: https://github.com/felixalmesberger/AUTOCAD-MCP (optional build via -WithFelix; raw disabled by default)
autodesk_official: AutoCAD/Civil 3D MCP Tech Preview + Product Help MCP
validation_note: Automated tests (unit, real-MCP-subprocess session tests, protocol-level end-to-end with a fake AutoCAD), ruff, contract check of allow-lists and sent parameters against the real best-cad-mcp/Slacker schemas, and a smoke run against the real backend processes with AutoCAD NOT running. Live AutoCAD COM/DWG verification (read-back verification per entity type, staging, text rotation/alignment via best) must be run on the user's Windows AutoCAD 2026 installation via DOCTOR.cmd and the Smoke Test in README.md.
